acceptanceCriteria: doccompiler process groups are recorded in the live registry, or a test pins doccompiler as unreachable from adapter exit paths so a new edge fails loudly.
Focused tests pass on Darwin; Linux NOT_RUN retained if not run.
body: Found by the V1-1040 lane inventory (callgraph VTA, 2026-10-09). doccompiler starts its process groups through groupreap.Run without recording them in the groupreap live registry. Today it is unreachable from an exiting host adapter, so exitProcess does not need it, but a future call path would leave the group running. Suspected latent defect, not a reproduced leak.

title: doccompiler uses unregistered groupreap.Run, so an exiting adapter would leak its group if it became reachable
